91	pub fn acquire_lock(
92	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
93	    task_key: &str,
94	    run_id: &str,
95	    scope: &str,
96	    phase: &str,
97	    // Kept for status displays via lock_status; never authorizes reclaim.
98	    _stale_after: Duration,
99	) -> Result<LockGuard> {
100	    // REPORT.md: Multi-Agent Worktree Coordination Layer starts with scoped
101	    // locks so parallel agents do not claim the same task at once.
102	    fs::create_dir_all(paths.locks_dir()).with_path(paths.locks_dir())?;
103	    let path = lock_path(paths, scope, task_key);
104	    let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
105	        .create(true)
106	        .read(true)
107	        .write(true)
108	        .truncate(false)
109	        .open(&path)
110	        .with_path(&path)?;
111	
112	    match file.try_lock_exclusive() {
113	        Ok(()) => {}
114	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
115	            if let Some(existing) = read_lock_state(&path)? {
116	                return Err(DeadreckonError::LockHeld {
117	                    task_key: task_key.to_string(),
118	                    heartbeat_age_seconds: heartbeat_age_seconds(&existing),
119	                    run_id: existing.run_id,
120	                    phase: existing.phase,
121	                });
122	            }
123	            return Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source });
124	        }
125	        Err(source) => return Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
126	    }
127	
128	    let existing = read_lock_state_from_file(&mut file, &path)?;
129	    if let Some(existing) = existing {
130	        let alive = pid_is_alive(existing.pid);
131	        let same_owner = existing.run_id == run_id;
132	        // An alive holder is never usurped, however stale its heartbeat —
133	        // a wedged-but-running owner still owns its working tree. Reclaim
134	        // requires a dead pid; `deadreckon kill <run-id> --force` is the
135	        // operator path past a wedged holder.
136	        if !same_owner && alive {
137	            file.unlock().with_path(&path)?;
138	            return Err(DeadreckonError::LockHeld {
139	                task_key: task_key.to_string(),
140	                heartbeat_age_seconds: heartbeat_age_seconds(&existing),
141	                run_id: existing.run_id,
142	                phase: existing.phase,
143	            });
144	        }
145	    }
146	
147	    // AS-BUILT §6: process-held locks are paired with a durable heartbeat so
148	    // a successor can distinguish live work from crash residue.
149	    let now = Utc::now();
150	    let state = LockState {
151	        task_key: task_key.to_string(),
152	        run_id: run_id.to_string(),
153	        scope: scope.to_string(),
154	        phase: phase.to_string(),
155	        pid: std::process::id(),
156	        acquired_at: now,
157	        updated_at: now,
158	    };
159	    write_lock_state_to_file(&mut file, &path, &state)?;
160	    Ok(LockGuard {
161	        path,
162	        file,
163	        state,
164	        released: false,
165	    })
166	}

168	pub fn lock_status(
169	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
170	    scope: &str,
171	    task_key: &str,
172	    stale_after: Duration,
173	) -> Result<LockStatus> {
174	    let path = lock_path(paths, scope, task_key);
175	    let Some(state) = read_lock_state(&path)? else {

204	pub fn lock_is_stale(state: &LockState, stale_after: Duration) -> bool {
205	    let age = Utc::now()
206	        .signed_duration_since(state.updated_at)
207	        .to_std()
208	        .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);

271	fn read_lock_state(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<LockState>> {
272	    match fs::read(path) {
273	        Ok(data) if data.is_empty() => Ok(None),
274	        Ok(data) => serde_json::from_slice(&data).map(Some).with_json_path(path),
275	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
276	        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io {
277	            path: path.to_path_buf(),
278	            source,
279	        }),
280	    }
281	}
282	
283	fn read_lock_state_from_file(file: &mut File, path: &Path) -> Result<Option<LockState>> {
284	    file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0)).with_path(path)?;
285	    let mut data = Vec::new();
286	    file.read_to_end(&mut data).with_path(path)?;
287	    if data.is_empty() {
288	        return Ok(None);
289	    }
290	    serde_json::from_slice(&data).map(Some).with_json_path(path)
291	}
292	
293	fn write_lock_state_to_file(file: &mut File, path: &Path, state: &LockState) -> Result<()> {
294	    file.set_len(0).with_path(path)?;
295	    file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0)).with_path(path)?;
296	    serde_json::to_writer_pretty(&mut *file, state).with_json_path(path)?;
297	    file.write_all(b"\n").with_path(path)?;
298	    file.sync_all().with_path(path)
299	}

4	pub enum DeadreckonError {
5	    #[error("I/O error at {path}: {source}")]
6	    Io {
7	        path: PathBuf,
8	        #[source]
9	        source: std::io::Error,
10	    },
11	    #[error("JSON error at {path}: {source}")]
12	    Json {
13	        path: PathBuf,
14	        #[source]
15	        source: serde_json::Error,
16	    },
17	    #[error("invalid input: {0}")]
18	    InvalidInput(String),
19	    #[error("not found: {0}")]
20	    NotFound(String),
21	    #[error(
22	        "lock held for {task_key} by run {run_id} in phase {phase} (heartbeat {heartbeat_age_seconds}s ago)"
23	    )]
24	    LockHeld {
25	        task_key: String,
26	        run_id: String,
27	        phase: String,
28	        heartbeat_age_seconds: u64,
29	    },
30	}
31	
32	impl DeadreckonError {
33	    /// Transient — the operation may succeed on a retry.
34	    pub fn is_retryable(&self) -> bool {
35	        match self {
36	            DeadreckonError::Io { source, .. } => is_retryable_io_kind(source.kind()),
37	            DeadreckonError::Json { .. } => false,
38	            DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(_) => false,
39	            DeadreckonError::NotFound(_) => false,
40	            DeadreckonError::LockHeld { .. } => true,
41	        }
42	    }
43	
44	    /// Unrecoverable — the watchdog should escalate, not retry.
45	    pub fn is_fatal(&self) -> bool {
46	        match self {
47	            DeadreckonError::Io { source, .. } => !is_retryable_io_kind(source.kind()),
48	            DeadreckonError::Json { .. } => true,
49	            DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(_) => true,
50	            DeadreckonError::NotFound(_) => true,
51	            DeadreckonError::LockHeld { .. } => false,
52	        }
53	    }
54	}
55	
56	pub fn is_retryable_io_kind(kind: std::io::ErrorKind) -> bool {
57	    matches!(
58	        kind,
59	        std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted
60	            | std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
61	            | std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut
62	            | std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionReset
63	            | std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionAborted
64	            | std::io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe
65	    )
66	}
67	
68	pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, DeadreckonError>;

70	pub(crate) trait IoContext<T> {
71	    fn with_path(self, path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Result<T>;
72	}
73	
74	impl<T> IoContext<T> for std::io::Result<T> {
75	    fn with_path(self, path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Result<T> {
76	        let path = path.into();
77	        self.map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io { path, source })
78	    }
79	}

83	}

3	pub(crate) async fn plan_command(args: PlanCommandArgs) -> Result<()> {

5	    let no_hints = args.no_hints;

201	pub(crate) fn resolve_plan_providers(
202	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
203	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
204	    mode: PlanMode,
205	    planner_provider: Option<String>,
206	    provider: Option<String>,
207	    coder_provider: Option<String>,

216	    let planner = match mode {

220	            planner_provider
221	                .or(default_child.clone())

223	        )?,
224	        PlanMode::Review => None,
225	    };
226	    let coder = match mode {
227	        PlanMode::Review => resolve_provider_name(
228	            paths,
229	            setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Coder,
230	            coder_provider
231	                .or(default_child.clone())
232	                .or(defaults.provider.clone()),
233	        )?,
234	        PlanMode::FullPlan => None,
235	    };
236	    let reviewer = match mode {
237	        PlanMode::Review => resolve_provider_name(
238	            paths,

240	            reviewer_provider
241	                .or(default_child.clone())
242	                .or(defaults.provider.clone()),
243	        )?,
244	        PlanMode::FullPlan => None,
245	    };
246	    let configured_model = defaults.model.as_ref();
247	    Ok(PlanProviders {
248	        planner_model: planner.as_ref().and(resolve_role_model(
249	            models.planner_model.as_ref(),
250	            models.model.as_ref(),
251	            configured_model,
252	        )),
253	        default_child_model: resolve_role_model(None, models.model.as_ref(), configured_model),
254	        coder_model: coder.as_ref().and(resolve_role_model(
255	            models.coder_model.as_ref(),
256	            models.model.as_ref(),
257	            configured_model,
258	        )),

260	            models.reviewer_model.as_ref(),
261	            models.model.as_ref(),
262	            configured_model,
263	        )),
264	        child_models: models.child_models,
265	        planner,
266	        default_child,

311	pub(crate) fn parse_child_provider_overrides(
312	    values: &[String],
313	    n: u8,
314	) -> Result<BTreeMap<u32, String>> {
315	    let mut overrides = BTreeMap::new();
316	    for value in values {
317	        let Some((idx, provider)) = value.split_once('=') else {
318	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
319	                &format!("child provider override must be IDX=PROVIDER: {value}"),
320	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
321	            )));
322	        };
323	        let index = idx.trim().parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| {
324	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
325	                &format!("child provider index is not a number: {idx}"),
326	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
327	            ))
328	        })?;
329	        if index >= u32::from(n) {
330	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
331	                &format!("child provider index {index} outside 0..{n}"),
332	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
333	            )));
334	        }
335	        let provider = provider.trim();
336	        if provider.is_empty() {
337	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
338	                "child provider must be non-empty",
339	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
340	            )));
341	        }
342	        overrides.insert(index, provider.to_string());
343	    }
344	    Ok(overrides)
345	}
346	
347	pub(crate) async fn build_full_plan_tasks(
348	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
349	    goal: &str,
350	    n: u8,
351	    providers: &PlanProviders,
352	    overrides: &BTreeMap<u32, String>,
353	    cwd: &Path,
354	    plain: bool,
355	    no_hints: bool,
356	    json_output: bool,
357	) -> Result<Vec<PlanTask>> {
358	    let drafts = if providers
359	        .planner
360	        .as_deref()
361	        .is_some_and(|provider| provider == "smoke" || provider.starts_with("smoke:"))
362	    {
363	        deterministic_plan_drafts(goal, n)
364	    } else {
365	        provider_plan_drafts(paths, goal, n, providers.planner.as_deref(), cwd, plain).await?
366	    };
367	    if drafts.len() != usize::from(n) {
368	        return Err(plan_refusal_error(
369	            &format!("provider returned {} children; need {n}", drafts.len()),
370	            "DeadReckon did not save the plan because the planner returned the wrong number of child tasks.",
371	            "The requested child count is part of the orchestration contract; saving a partial graph would make later fork/merge state misleading.",
372	            vec![
373	                ("requested children".to_string(), n.to_string()),
374	                ("returned children".to_string(), drafts.len().to_string()),
375	                (
376	                    "planner".to_string(),
377	                    providers
378	                        .planner
379	                        .as_deref()
380	                        .unwrap_or("default planner")
381	                        .to_string(),
382	                ),
383	            ],
384	            "deadreckon plan ... --provider <other>".to_string(),
385	            vec!["deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()],
386	            no_hints,
387	            json_output,
388	        ));
389	    }
390	    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
391	    for (index, draft) in drafts.into_iter().enumerate() {
392	        let index = index as u32;
393	        let provider = overrides
394	            .get(&index)
395	            .cloned()
396	            .or_else(|| providers.default_child.clone());
397	        let mut task = PlanTask::new(index, draft.subject, draft.goal, PlanRole::Child, provider);
398	        task.active_form = draft.active_form.unwrap_or_else(|| task.subject.clone());
399	        task.depends_on = draft.depends_on;
400	        tasks.push(task);
401	    }
402	    Ok(tasks)
403	}
404	
405	fn validate_plan_task_count(goal: &str, n: u8, no_hints: bool, json_output: bool) -> Result<()> {
406	    match usize::from(n) {
407	        0 | 1 => Err(plan_refusal_error(
408	            "plan must have >= 2 children",
409	            "DeadReckon did not create a plan because the requested child count is too small.",
410	            "A full plan needs at least two child tasks; for one task, a direct run is the truthful execution shape.",
411	            vec![("requested children".to_string(), n.to_string())],
412	            "deadreckon run \"<the only child>\"".to_string(),
413	            vec![format!(
414	                "deadreckon plan {} --n 2",
415	                plan_goal_argument(goal)
416	            )],
417	            no_hints,
418	            json_output,
419	        )),
420	        2..=6 => Ok(()),
421	        count => Err(plan_refusal_error(
422	            &format!("plan capped at 6 children; got {count}"),
423	            "DeadReckon did not create a plan because the requested child count is above the full-plan cap.",
424	            "Full-plan orchestration is capped at six parallel children; a sequential chain is the safer shape for larger decompositions.",
425	            vec![("requested children".to_string(), n.to_string())],
426	            format!("deadreckon chain plan {} --n {n}", plan_goal_argument(goal)),
427	            vec![format!(
428	                "deadreckon plan {} --n 6",
429	                plan_goal_argument(goal)
430	            )],
431	            no_hints,
432	            json_output,
433	        )),
434	    }
435	}
436	
437	fn plan_refusal_error(
438	    message: impl Into<String>,
439	    what_happened: impl Into<String>,
440	    why_this_verdict: impl Into<String>,
441	    evidence: Vec<(String, String)>,
442	    primary: String,
443	    secondary: Vec<String>,
444	    no_hints: bool,
445	    json_output: bool,
446	) -> CliError {
447	    let message = message.into();
448	    let mut all_evidence = vec![("reason".to_string(), message)];
449	    all_evidence.extend(evidence);
450	    let secondary = secondary
451	        .iter()
452	        .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
453	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
454	    let surface = VerdictSurface::try_new(
455	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
456	        "plan",
457	        None,
458	        ExplanationPanel::new(what_happened, why_this_verdict, all_evidence),
459	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
460	        secondary,
461	    )
462	    .expect("plan refusal verdict surface must be valid");
463	    let rendered = if json_output {
464	        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
465	            "kind": "plan_refusal",
466	            "error": surface.explanation.evidence[0].1.clone(),
467	            "next_actions": [surface.primary_action.command.clone()],
468	        })))
469	        .expect("plan refusal verdict json must serialize")
470	    } else {
471	        surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints))
472	    };
473	    CliError::Surface {
474	        code: 1,
475	        surface: rendered,
476	    }
477	}

502	    reviewer.depends_on = vec![coder.task_id.clone()];
503	    vec![coder, reviewer]
504	}

506	#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
507	struct PlannerDraft {
508	    subject: String,
509	    goal: String,
510	    #[serde(default)]
511	    active_form: Option<String>,
512	    #[serde(default)]
513	    depends_on: Vec<String>,
514	}

516	#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
517	struct PlannerObjectDraft {
518	    tasks: Vec<PlannerDraft>,
519	}

521	async fn provider_plan_drafts(
522	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
523	    goal: &str,
524	    n: u8,
525	    planner_provider: Option<&str>,
526	    cwd: &Path,
527	    plain: bool,
528	) -> Result<Vec<PlannerDraft>> {
529	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), planner_provider)?;
530	    let prompt = planner_prompt(goal, n);
531	    let request = ProviderRequest {
532	        prompt,
533	        max_output_tokens: 4096,
534	        cwd: Some(cwd.to_path_buf()),
535	        output_path: None,
536	        sandbox_backend: None,
537	        pid_file: None,
538	        cancellation_token: None,
539	    };
540	    let response =
541	        maybe_with_cli_wait_status(!plain, "planning child graph", router.complete(&request))
542	            .await?;
543	    parse_planner_response(&response.content)
544	}
545	
546	fn planner_prompt(goal: &str, n: u8) -> String {
547	    format!(
548	        "You are a read-only planning agent for deadreckon. Do not write files, create temporary files, install packages, commit, delete, move, or mutate state. Inspect only if your provider supports read-only tools.\n\nReturn JSON only. Shape: {{\"tasks\":[{{\"subject\":\"imperative label\",\"goal\":\"self-contained child goal\",\"active_form\":\"present-progress text\",\"depends_on\":[\"task-0\"]}}]}}. Return exactly {n} child entries in the tasks array. Dependencies must refer to earlier child ids task-0..task-{} and form a DAG.\n\nChild hygiene:\n- Prefer child ids in execution order; earlier children should unblock later children.\n- For build/product goals, child goals must be implementation or verification slices that create or edit project files and move toward runnable behavior.\n- Do not return research-only, sourcing-only, architecture-only, or roadmap-only children unless the user explicitly asked for planning or research documentation.\n- Split independent implementation work into separate children; use research only as a dependency that directly unblocks concrete implementation.\n- Give each child enough context to run without seeing the user conversation, including likely files/modules/features and acceptance checks.\n- Never write \"based on the other worker\"; include the concrete dependency output the child will need.\n\nGoal: {goal}",
549	        n.saturating_sub(1)
550	    )
551	}
552	
553	fn parse_planner_response(content: &str) -> Result<Vec<PlannerDraft>> {
554	    if let Ok(object) = serde_json::from_str::<PlannerObjectDraft>(content) {
555	        return Ok(object.tasks);
556	    }
557	    if let Ok(tasks) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<PlannerDraft>>(content) {
558	        return Ok(tasks);
559	    }
560	    if let Some(slice) = json_slice(content, '{', '}')
561	        && let Ok(object) = serde_json::from_str::<PlannerObjectDraft>(slice)
562	    {
563	        return Ok(object.tasks);
564	    }
565	    if let Some(slice) = json_slice(content, '[', ']')
566	        && let Ok(tasks) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<PlannerDraft>>(slice)
567	    {
568	        return Ok(tasks);
569	    }
570	    Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
571	        "planner provider did not return a valid child JSON object",
572	        "deadreckon plan ... --planner-provider <other>",
573	    )))
574	}
575	
576	pub(crate) fn json_slice(content: &str, open: char, close: char) -> Option<&str> {
577	    let start = content.find(open)?;
578	    let end = content.rfind(close)?;
579	    (end >= start).then_some(&content[start..=end])
580	}

582	fn deterministic_plan_drafts(goal: &str, n: u8) -> Vec<PlannerDraft> {
583	    (0..n)
584	        .map(|index| PlannerDraft {
585	            subject: match index {
586	                0 => "Create foundation".to_string(),
587	                1 => "Add behavior".to_string(),
588	                _ => format!("Complete slice {}", index + 1),
589	            },
590	            goal: format!("{goal} (child {} of {n})", index + 1),
591	            active_form: Some(match index {
592	                0 => "Creating foundation".to_string(),
593	                1 => "Adding behavior".to_string(),
594	                _ => format!("Completing slice {}", index + 1),
595	            }),
596	            depends_on: Vec::new(),
597	        })
598	        .collect()
599	}

601	fn infer_capability_preview(goal: &str) -> deadreckon_core::CapabilityPreview {
602	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
603	    let deploy = ["deploy", "vercel", "netlify", "production"]
604	        .iter()
605	        .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
606	    let global_install = ["install globally", "global install", "npm -g"]
607	        .iter()
608	        .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
609	    let networked = [
610	        "api",
611	        "websocket",
612	        "web socket",
613	        "multiplayer",
614	        "online",
615	        "networked",
616	        "real-time",
617	        "real time",
618	        "realtime",
619	        "live",
620	        "server",
621	        "client/server",
622	        "asset source",
623	        "asset sourcing",
624	        "terrain data",
625	        "mapbox",
626	        "cesium",
627	    ]
628	    .iter()
629	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
630	    let network = if deploy || networked {
631	        deadreckon_core::NetworkCapability::Allowlist
632	    } else {
633	        deadreckon_core::NetworkCapability::Deny
634	    };
635	    let mut notes = Vec::new();
636	    if deploy {
637	        notes.push(
638	            "goal mentions deployment; require explicit capability before deploy".to_string(),
639	        );
640	    }
641	    if global_install {
642	        notes.push("goal mentions global install; require explicit capability".to_string());
643	    }
644	    deadreckon_core::CapabilityPreview {
645	        network,
646	        deploy,
647	        global_install,
648	        filesystem: vec!["working directory".to_string()],
649	        notes,
650	    }
651	}

653	fn render_worker_spec(plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> String {
654	    let dependencies = if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
655	        "none".to_string()
656	    } else {
657	        task.depends_on.join(", ")
658	    };
659	    let acceptance_line = plan
660	        .acceptance_path
661	        .as_ref()
662	        .map(|path| {
663	            format!(
664	                "- dr-gate will enforce configured done criteria from {}.",
665	                path.display()
666	            )
667	        })
668	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
669	            "- dr-gate will use the default local gate if no project done criteria exist."
670	                .to_string()
671	        });
672	    format!(
673	        "# deadreckon worker spec: {}\n\nRoot goal: {}\nChild id: {}\nRole: {:?}\nProvider: {}\nDependencies satisfied before start: {}\n\n## Scope\n{}\n\n## Capability constraints\n- network: {:?}\n- deploy: {}\n- global install: {}\n- filesystem: {}\n\n## Coordination rules\n- Treat this file as the complete brief; do not assume access to the parent conversation.\n- Do not inspect, tail, or summarize sibling child transcripts; wait for dependency summaries included below.\n- If correcting your own failed check, keep the same context and fix the root cause.\n- If acting as reviewer, approach the artifact with fresh assumptions and verify independently.\n- Report blockers as concrete file paths, command output, or acceptance failures.\n\n## Done criteria\n{}\n- Stay within this child's scope.\n- Verify relevant behavior before reporting done.\n- Do not spawn subagents or orchestrate more children.\n- Do not editorialize between tool calls.\n- Report scope, result, key files, files changed, and issues.\n",
674	        task.subject,
675	        plan.root_goal,
676	        task.task_id,
677	        task.role,
678	        task.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("config default"),
679	        dependencies,
680	        task.goal,
681	        plan.capability_preview.network,
682	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
683	        plan.capability_preview.global_install,
684	        plan.capability_preview.filesystem.join(", "),
685	        acceptance_line
686	    )
687	}

689	fn render_launch_worker_spec(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> String {
690	    let mut spec = render_worker_spec(plan, task);
691	    let dependency_summaries = task
692	        .depends_on
693	        .iter()
694	        .filter_map(|dependency| plan.task_by_id(dependency))
695	        .filter_map(|dependency| {
696	            let summary_path = dependency.summary_path.as_ref()?;
697	            let absolute = paths.plan_dir(&plan.plan_id).join(summary_path);
698	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(&absolute).ok()?;
699	            Some((dependency, absolute, truncate_for_worker_spec(&raw)))
700	        })
701	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
702	    if dependency_summaries.is_empty() {
703	        return spec;
704	    }
705	    spec.push_str("\n## Dependency summaries\n");
706	    for (dependency, absolute, summary) in dependency_summaries {
707	        spec.push_str(&format!(
708	            "\n### {} - {}\n\nSummary path: {}\n\n{}\n",
709	            dependency.task_id,
710	            dependency.subject,
711	            absolute.display(),
712	            summary.trim()
713	        ));
714	    }
715	    spec
716	}
717	
718	fn truncate_for_worker_spec(raw: &str) -> String {
719	    const MAX_CHARS: usize = 4_000;
720	    let mut chars = raw.chars();
721	    let truncated = chars.by_ref().take(MAX_CHARS).collect::<String>();
722	    if chars.next().is_some() {
723	        format!("{truncated}\n\n... truncated ...")
724	    } else {
725	        truncated
726	    }
727	}

734	        Ok(Some(git)) => format!("git branch={} @ {}", git.branch, git.head_sha),

750	pub(crate) fn plan_next_actions(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
751	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
752	    match plan.status {
753	        PlanStatus::Pending => vec![format!("deadreckon fork {id}")],
754	        PlanStatus::Forked => {
755	            if plan
756	                .tasks
757	                .iter()
758	                .all(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
759	            {
760	                vec![format!("deadreckon merge {id}")]
761	            } else {
762	                vec![format!("deadreckon attach {id}")]
763	            }
764	        }
765	        PlanStatus::Merged => vec![format!("deadreckon finish {id}")],
766	        PlanStatus::Failed => vec![format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")],
767	    }
768	}
769	
770	pub(crate) fn plan_next_actions_with_context(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
771	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
772	    match plan.status {
773	        PlanStatus::Failed if plan_has_repair_evidence(paths, plan) => vec![
774	            format!("deadreckon merge {id}"),
775	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed"),
776	        ],
777	        _ => plan_next_actions(plan),
778	    }
779	}
780	
781	pub(crate) fn plan_verdict_surface(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> VerdictSurface {
782	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
783	    let completed = plan
784	        .tasks
785	        .iter()
786	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
787	        .count();
788	    let total = plan.tasks.len();
789	    let repairable = plan_has_repair_evidence(paths, plan);
790	    let (kind, what, why) = match plan.status {
791	        PlanStatus::Pending => (
792	            VerdictKind::Preview,
793	            "DeadReckon wrote the plan graph, but no child run has started yet.",
794	            "This is a pre-fork plan state; forking is the one command that advances it.",
795	        ),
796	        PlanStatus::Forked
797	            if plan
798	                .tasks
799	                .iter()
800	                .all(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed) =>
801	        {
802	            (
803	                VerdictKind::Completed,
804	                "All child runs completed and the plan is ready to merge.",
805	                "The next state-changing command composes the child artifacts into one result.",
806	            )
807	        }
808	        PlanStatus::Forked => (
809	            VerdictKind::Paused,
810	            "The plan has launched child work and is not merged yet.",
811	            "Attaching is the safest next command because the plan still has active or pending child state.",
812	        ),
813	        PlanStatus::Merged => (
814	            VerdictKind::Completed,
815	            "The plan merged its child results into a promoted result run.",
816	            "DeadReckon has a merged artifact; the recommended command lands or exports that result.",
817	        ),
818	        PlanStatus::Failed if repairable => (
819	            VerdictKind::Failed,
820	            "The plan stopped before producing a merged result.",
821	            "Merge-repair evidence exists, so rerunning merge is the safest recovery path before inspection-only commands.",
822	        ),
823	        PlanStatus::Failed => (
824	            VerdictKind::Failed,
825	            "The plan stopped before producing a merged result.",
826	            "No repair evidence is available, so the why-failed view is the safest next inspection command.",
827	        ),
828	    };
829	    let mut evidence = vec![
830	        ("plan".to_string(), id.clone()),
831	        (
832	            "status".to_string(),
833	            plan_status_label(plan.status).to_string(),
834	        ),
835	        (
836	            "tasks".to_string(),
837	            format!("{completed}/{total} completed"),
838	        ),
839	        (
840	            "events".to_string(),
841	            paths.plan_events(&plan.plan_id).display().to_string(),
842	        ),
843	    ];
844	    if let Some(merged_run_id) = plan.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
845	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(merged_run_id)));
846	    }
847	    if repairable {
848	        evidence.push((
849	            "repair evidence".to_string(),
850	            paths.merge_proofs(&plan.plan_id).display().to_string(),
851	        ));
852	    }
853	    let primary = plan_next_actions_with_context(paths, plan)
854	        .into_iter()
855	        .next()
856	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id}"));
857	    let secondary = plan_secondary_actions(paths, plan, &primary);
858	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
859	        kind,
860	        "plan",
861	        Some(&id),
862	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
863	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
864	        secondary
865	            .iter()
866	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
867	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
868	    )
869	    .expect("plan verdict surface must have one primary action")
870	}
871	
872	fn plan_secondary_actions(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
873	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
874	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
875	    for command in plan_next_actions_with_context(paths, plan) {
876	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
877	            actions.push(command);
878	        }
879	    }
880	    let inspection = if plan.status == PlanStatus::Failed {
881	        format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
882	    } else {
883	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
884	    };
885	    for command in [format!("deadreckon attach {id}"), inspection] {
886	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
887	            actions.push(command);
888	        }
889	    }
890	    actions
891	}
892	
893	fn plan_has_repair_evidence(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> bool {
894	    let proofs = paths.merge_proofs(&plan.plan_id);
895	    [
896	        "conflicts.json",
897	        "repair-request.json",
898	        "repair-plan.json",
899	        "repair-run.json",
900	    ]
901	    .iter()
902	    .any(|name| proofs.join(name).is_file())
903	}

947	pub(crate) fn orchestration_provider_role_rows(
948	    plan: &Plan,
949	    repair_enabled: bool,
950	    repair_provider: Option<&str>,
951	) -> Vec<OrchestrationRoleRow> {
952	    let mut rows = Vec::new();
953	    match plan.mode {
954	        PlanMode::FullPlan => {
955	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
956	                "planner",
957	                plan.providers.planner.as_deref(),
958	                plan.providers.planner_model.as_deref(),
959	                "plan",
960	                "writes child graph",
961	            ));
962	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
963	                "default child",
964	                plan.providers.default_child.as_deref(),
965	                plan.providers.default_child_model.as_deref(),
966	                "plan",
967	                "runs ready children",
968	            ));
969	            let mut seen_overrides = BTreeSet::new();
970	            let mut override_indexes: BTreeSet<u32> =
971	                plan.providers.children.keys().copied().collect();
972	            override_indexes.extend(plan.providers.child_models.keys().copied());
973	            for index in override_indexes {
974	                seen_overrides.insert(index);
975	                let route = plan.providers.children.get(&index);
976	                rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
977	                    format!("child task-{index}"),
978	                    route.map(String::as_str),
979	                    plan.providers
980	                        .child_models
981	                        .get(&index)
982	                        .or(plan.providers.default_child_model.as_ref())
983	                        .map(String::as_str),
984	                    "override",
985	                    "per-child route",
986	                ));
987	            }
988	            for task in &plan.tasks {
989	                let default_route = plan.providers.default_child.as_deref();
990	                if task.provider.as_deref().is_some()
991	                    && task.provider.as_deref() != default_route
992	                    && !seen_overrides.contains(&task.index)
993	                {
994	                    rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
995	                        format!("child {}", task.task_id),
996	                        task.provider.as_deref(),
997	                        plan.providers
998	                            .child_models
999	                            .get(&task.index)
1000	                            .or(plan.providers.default_child_model.as_ref())
1001	                            .map(String::as_str),
1002	                        "task",
1003	                        one_line(&task.subject, 30),
1004	                    ));
1005	                }
1006	            }
1007	        }
1008	        PlanMode::Review => {
1009	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
1010	                "coder",
1011	                plan.providers.coder.as_deref(),
1012	                plan.providers.coder_model.as_deref(),
1013	                "plan",
1014	                "implementation pass",
1015	            ));
1016	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
1017	                "reviewer",
1018	                plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref(),
1019	                plan.providers.reviewer_model.as_deref(),
1020	                "plan",
1021	                "independent review",
1022	            ));
1023	        }
1024	    }
1025	    if repair_enabled {
1026	        let derived = repair_provider
1027	            .or(plan.providers.planner.as_deref())
1028	            .or(plan.providers.default_child.as_deref())
1029	            .or(plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref())
1030	            .or(plan.providers.coder.as_deref());
1031	        rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
1032	            "repair",
1033	            derived,
1034	            plan.providers.planner_model.as_deref(),
1035	            if repair_provider.is_some() {
1036	                "flag"
1037	            } else {
1038	                "derived"
1039	            },
1040	            "merge repair planning",
1041	        ));
1042	    } else {
1043	        rows.push(OrchestrationRoleRow {
1044	            role: "repair".to_string(),
1045	            route: "disabled".to_string(),
1046	            model: "-".to_string(),
1047	            source: "--no-repair".to_string(),
1048	            notes: "raw conflict refusal".to_string(),
1049	        });
1050	    }
1051	    rows
1052	}

1054	/// The model a child run launches with: per-index override, else the
1055	/// default-child model. None (or the literal "provider default") means the
1056	/// provider's own default — no --model argument reaches the child.
1057	pub(crate) fn child_model_for_task<'a>(
1058	    providers: &'a PlanProviders,
1059	    task: &deadreckon_core::plan::PlanTask,
1060	) -> Option<&'a str> {
1061	    providers
1062	        .child_models
1063	        .get(&task.index)
1064	        .or(providers.default_child_model.as_ref())
1065	        .map(String::as_str)
1066	        .filter(|model| *model != "provider default" && !model.trim().is_empty())
1067	}

1122	pub(crate) fn orchestration_dependency_rows(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<OrchestrationDependencyRow> {
1123	    let completed = plan
1124	        .tasks
1125	        .iter()
1126	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1127	        .map(|task| task.task_id.as_str())
1128	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1129	    plan.tasks
1130	        .iter()
1131	        .map(|task| {
1132	            let blockers = task
1133	                .depends_on
1134	                .iter()
1135	                .filter(|dependency| !completed.contains(dependency.as_str()))
1136	                .cloned()
1137	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1138	            let starts = match task.status {
1139	                PlanTaskStatus::Pending if blockers.is_empty() => "now".to_string(),
1140	                PlanTaskStatus::Pending => format!("after {}", blockers.join(",")),
1141	                PlanTaskStatus::Running => "already running".to_string(),
1142	                PlanTaskStatus::Completed => "done".to_string(),
1143	                PlanTaskStatus::Failed => "failed".to_string(),
1144	                PlanTaskStatus::Killed => "killed".to_string(),
1145	            };
1146	            let unblocks = plan
1147	                .tasks
1148	                .iter()
1149	                .filter(|candidate| candidate.depends_on.iter().any(|dep| dep == &task.task_id))
1150	                .map(|candidate| candidate.task_id.clone())
1151	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1152	            OrchestrationDependencyRow {
1153	                child: task.task_id.clone(),
1154	                status: task_status_label(task.status).to_string(),
1155	                starts,
1156	                waits_for: if blockers.is_empty() {
1157	                    "-".to_string()
1158	                } else {
1159	                    blockers.join(",")
1160	                },
1161	                unblocks: if unblocks.is_empty() {
1162	                    "-".to_string()
1163	                } else {
1164	                    unblocks.join(",")
1165	                },
1166	            }
1167	        })
1168	        .collect()
1169	}
1170	
1171	pub(crate) fn orchestration_parallelism_lines(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
1172	    let rows = orchestration_dependency_rows(plan);
1173	    let starts_now = rows
1174	        .iter()
1175	        .filter(|row| row.starts == "now")
1176	        .map(|row| row.child.clone())
1177	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1178	    let waits = rows
1179	        .iter()
1180	        .filter(|row| row.waits_for != "-")
1181	        .map(|row| format!("{} after {}", row.child, row.waits_for))
1182	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1183	    vec![
1184	        format!(
1185	            "starts now: {}",
1186	            if starts_now.is_empty() {
1187	                "-".to_string()
1188	            } else {
1189	                starts_now.join(", ")
1190	            }
1191	        ),
1192	        format!(
1193	            "waits: {}",
1194	            if waits.is_empty() {
1195	                "-".to_string()
1196	            } else {
1197	                waits.join("; ")
1198	            }
1199	        ),
1200	    ]
1201	}

1203	pub(crate) fn print_orchestration_dependency_summary(plan: &Plan) {

1205	    for line in orchestration_parallelism_lines(plan) {
1206	        println!("  {line}");
1207	    }
1208	    println!("{}", ui_heading("dependencies"));
1209	    println!(
1210	        "  {} {} {} {} {}",
1211	        ui::pad_visible(&ui_muted("child"), 10),
1212	        ui::pad_visible(&ui_muted("status"), 10),
1213	        ui::pad_visible(&ui_muted("starts"), 18),
1214	        ui::pad_visible(&ui_muted("waits_for"), 18),
1215	        ui_muted("unblocks")
1216	    );
1217	    for row in orchestration_dependency_rows(plan) {
1218	        println!(
1219	            "  {} {} {:<18} {:<18} {}",
1220	            ui::pad_visible(&ui_id(&row.child), 10),
1221	            ui::pad_visible(&ui_status(&row.status), 10),
1222	            row.starts,
1223	            row.waits_for,
1224	            row.unblocks
1225	        );
1226	    }
1227	}

1229	fn print_plan_created(plan: &Plan, no_hints: bool) {
1230	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
1231	    println!(
1232	        "{}",
1233	        plan_verdict_surface(&paths, plan).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints))
1234	    );
1235	    let ready = plan.ready_pending_task_indices().len();
1236	    let pending = plan
1237	        .tasks
1238	        .iter()
1239	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Pending)
1240	        .count();
1241	    let blocked = pending.saturating_sub(ready);
1242	    let children = format!(
1243	        "{} ({} ready / {} blocked)",
1244	        plan.tasks.len(),
1245	        ready,
1246	        blocked
1247	    );
1248	    let providers = match plan.mode {
1249	        PlanMode::FullPlan => format!(
1250	            "planner={} default-child={}",
1251	            plan.providers.planner.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1252	            plan.providers.default_child.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
1253	        ),
1254	        PlanMode::Review => format!(
1255	            "coder={} reviewer={}",
1256	            plan.providers.coder.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1257	            plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
1258	        ),
1259	    };
1260	    let capabilities = format!(
1261	        "network={:?} deploy={} install={}",
1262	        plan.capability_preview.network,
1263	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
1264	        plan.capability_preview.global_install
1265	    );
1266	    let source = plan_source_label(plan);
1267	    let gate = plan_acceptance_label(plan);
1268	    let plan_path = paths.plan_json(&plan.plan_id);
1269	    let plan_path_display = plan_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
1270	    let items = [
1271	        ("status", plan_status_label(plan.status)),
1272	        ("mode", plan_mode_label(plan.mode)),
1273	        ("children", children.as_str()),
1274	        ("providers", providers.as_str()),
1275	        ("source", source.as_str()),
1276	        (NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT, gate.as_str()),
1277	        ("capabilities", capabilities.as_str()),
1278	        ("plan", plan_path_display.as_str()),
1279	    ];
1280	    print_kv_block(&items);
1281	    print_orchestration_role_table(plan, true, None);
1282	    print_orchestration_dependency_summary(plan);
1283	    for task in &plan.tasks {
1284	        let deps = if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
1285	            "-".to_string()
1286	        } else {
1287	            task.depends_on.join(",")
1288	        };
1289	        println!(
1290	            "  {} {} [{}] provider={} deps={}",
1291	            ui_id(&task.task_id),
1292	            task.subject,
1293	            format!("{:?}", task.role).to_ascii_lowercase(),
1294	            task.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1295	            deps
1296	        );
1297	    }
1298	}

1300	pub(crate) fn print_orchestrate_preflight(
1301	    plan: &Plan,
1302	    max_spend: Option<f64>,
1303	    max_wall_seconds: Option<f64>,
1304	    sandbox: Option<&str>,
1305	    no_repair: bool,
1306	) {
1307	    println!(
1308	        "{} {} ({})",
1309	        ui_heading("orchestrate preflight"),
1310	        ui_id(run_prefix(&plan.plan_id)),
1311	        plan.plan_id
1312	    );
1313	    let children = format!(
1314	        "{} ({})",
1315	        plan.tasks.len(),
1316	        orchestration_mode_summary(plan)
1317	    );
1318	    let spend = max_spend
1319	        .map(|value| format!("${value:.2} per child"))
1320	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "config default".to_string());
1321	    let wall = max_wall_seconds
1322	        .map(|value| format!("{value:.0}s per child"))
1323	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "config default".to_string());
1324	    let sandbox = sandbox.unwrap_or("config default").to_string();
1325	    let capabilities = format!(
1326	        "network={:?} deploy={} install={}",

1328	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
1329	        plan.capability_preview.global_install
1330	    );
1331	    let providers = plan_provider_summary(plan);
1332	    let source = plan_source_label(plan);
1333	    let gate = plan_acceptance_label(plan);
1334	    let repair = plan_repair_label(plan, no_repair);
1335	    let plan_ref = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
1336	    let path = orchestration_path_label(plan.mode);
1337	    let launch_rows = launch_preview_rows(&LaunchPreviewFacts {
1338	        goal: &plan.root_goal,
1339	        path,
1340	        suggestion: None,
1341	        provider: &providers,
1342	        model: plan.providers.default_child_model.clone(),
1343	        roles: None,
1344	        base: None,
1345	        history: None,
1346	        done: &gate,
1347	        workspace: &source,
1348	        watch: format!("deadreckon attach {plan_ref}"),
1349	        stop: format!("deadreckon kill {plan_ref}"),
1350	        finish: format!("deadreckon finish {plan_ref}"),
1351	        override_command: Some("deadreckon start <goal> --mode run".to_string()),
1352	    });
1353	    let mut items = vec![
1354	        ("goal".to_string(), plan.root_goal.clone()),
1355	        ("path".to_string(), path.to_string()),
1356	        ("mode".to_string(), plan_mode_label(plan.mode).to_string()),
1357	        ("children".to_string(), children),
1358	        ("providers".to_string(), providers.clone()),
1359	        ("provider".to_string(), providers),
1360	        ("source".to_string(), source.clone()),
1361	        ("workspace".to_string(), source),
1362	        (NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT.to_string(), gate.clone()),
1363	        ("done".to_string(), gate),
1364	        ("merge repair".to_string(), repair),
1365	        ("sandbox".to_string(), sandbox),
1366	        ("spend".to_string(), spend),
1367	        ("wall".to_string(), wall),
1368	        ("capabilities".to_string(), capabilities),
1369	    ];
1370	    items.extend(
1371	        launch_rows
1372	            .into_iter()
1373	            .filter(|(key, _)| matches!(key.as_str(), "watch" | "stop" | "finish" | "override")),
1374	    );
1375	    print_launch_preview_rows(&items);
1376	    print_orchestration_role_table(plan, !no_repair, None);
1377	    print_orchestration_dependency_summary(plan);
1378	    for task in &plan.tasks {
1379	        let deps = if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
1380	            "-".to_string()
1381	        } else {
1382	            task.depends_on.join(",")
1383	        };
1384	        println!(
1385	            "  {} {} [{}] provider={} deps={}",
1386	            ui_id(&task.task_id),
1387	            task.subject,
1388	            format!("{:?}", task.role).to_ascii_lowercase(),
1389	            task.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1390	            deps
1391	        );
1392	    }
1393	    let warnings = implementation_plan_warnings(plan);
1394	    if !warnings.is_empty() {
1395	        println!("{}", ui_warn("preflight warnings"));
1396	        for warning in warnings {
1397	            println!("  - {warning}");
1398	        }
1399	        println!(
1400	            "{}",
1401	            orchestrate_preflight_warning_recovery_line(&plan.plan_id)
1402	        );
1403	    }
1404	    println!(
1405	        "{} {}/plans/{}/plan.json",
1406	        ui_command("plan:"),
1407	        DeadreckonPaths::discover().home().display(),
1408	        plan.plan_id
1409	    );

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-06-10 21:33:36Z)**_

I've analyzed all five changed files. Summary of analysis:

**lock.rs**: The change is a **security hardening**, not a regression. Previously `acquire_lock` allowed reclaim when `stale && !same_owner && alive` (lock takeover based on heartbeat age, even from a live process). The new code: `if !same_owner && alive → refuse` — reclaim now requires a dead pid. This eliminates a hijack vector where a malicious or merely impatient peer could usurp a live-but-slow worker's lock by waiting out a stale-threshold.

**error.rs**: Adds `heartbeat_age_seconds: u64` to the `LockHeld` error. Pure telemetry; no sensitive data.

**main.rs `error_hint`**: Interpolates `run_id` from the `LockHeld` error into a suggested-command hint. The `run_id` originates from a JSON lock file under `~/.deadreckon/locks/`. Considered as a potential SENSITIVE-TO-OBSERVABILITY / shell-injection-via-copy-paste vector: the hint is *displayed*, not executed; lock files live in the invoking user's own home; and clap-parsed `deadreckon attach <run_id>` would treat unusual chars as arguments, not execute them. The only attack would be a user blindly copy-pasting a hint with an attacker-controlled run_id who already has write access to their home — a much weaker primitive than already exists. No actionable finding.

**plan.rs (core test) & commands/plan.rs**: Mechanical `Default` derivation; functionally equivalent to the removed `PlanModelOverrides::none()` and explicit struct init. No sink/state change.

No control regressions, no parser differentials, no new sinks, no missing gate parity. The substantive code change tightens the lock acquisition decision.
